summary: Blue Owl Real Estate Net Lease Trust filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 15,457,239 common shares for gross proceeds of ~$164.6M at NAV per share as of April 30, 2026, under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D/S. The filing also declares routine monthly distributions across share classes. This is a routine capital-raising and distribution announcement, not a transformative event. It is classified as None for special situations.
